Both sides are tautologies (all-T final columns), so they are equivalent.

| \(p\) | \(q\) | \(q \to p\) | \(p \to (q \to p)\) | \(\sim p\) | \(p \to q\) | \(\sim p \to (p \to q)\) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T | T | T | T | F | T | T |
| T | F | T | T | F | F | T |
| F | T | F | T | T | T | T |
| F | F | T | T | T | T | T |

Columns 4 and 7 are identical (both all T), hence \(p \to (q \to p) \equiv \sim p \to (p \to q)\).
